results.title: The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index
results.snippet: Foundation model developers are among the world's most important companies. As these companies become increasingly consequential, how do their transparency practices evolve? The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index is the third edition of an annual effort to characterize and quantify the transparency of foundation model developers. The 2025 FMTI introduces new indicators related to data acquisition, usage data, and monitoring and evaluates companies like Alibaba, DeepSeek, and xAI for the first time. The 2024 FMTI reported that transparency was improving, but the 2025 FMTI finds this prog…

results.title: Technical Report for ICRA 2025 GOOSE 3D Semantic Segmentation Challenge: Adaptive Point Cloud Understanding for Heterogeneous Robotic Systems
results.snippet: This technical report presents the implementation details of the winning solution for the ICRA 2025 GOOSE 3D Semantic Segmentation Challenge. This challenge focuses on semantic segmentation of 3D point clouds from diverse unstructured outdoor environments collected from multiple robotic platforms. This problem was addressed by implementing Point Prompt Tuning (PPT) integrated with Point Transformer v3 (PTv3) backbone, enabling adaptive processing of heterogeneous LiDAR data through platform-specific conditioning and cross-dataset class alignment strategies. The model is trained without requir…

results.title: Inference-Time Attention Steering for Vision-Language-Action Driving Models
results.snippet: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving models couple a reasoning stage with a diffusion-based trajectory decoder, but do not give a direct way to redirect attention toward safety-critical actors at inference time without retraining. We studied a bounded additive pre-softmax attention bias on the visual tokens of detector localized traffic actors on Alpamayo-R1's Qwen3-VL backbone. It is applied as a fail open forward pre-hook with no weight changes. On 50 lane-change scenarios from the Physical AI World Model Synthetic dataset. The trajectory decoder shows a monotonic dose response in the bias…

results.title: Compositional Context Fine-Tuning Vision-Language Model for Complex Assembly Action Understanding from Videos
results.snippet: Assembly action understanding is a key enabler for effective human-robot collaborative assembly, yet it remains challenging due to subtle motions and fine-grained hand-object interactions. We adapt vision-language models (VLMs) to this challenging domain with Compositional Context Fine-Tuning (CCFT), a method that decomposes assembly actions into semantic elements (Verb, Object, Tool) and fine-tunes VLMs to recognize each action element using templated question-answering pairs. This approach ensures near-deterministic outputs. To enable efficient and effective multi-task learning under limite…

findings.point: [26] 提出针对 VLA 驾驶模型的推理时注意力引导方法，在不重新训练的情况下通过在视觉 token 上施加有界加性 pre-softmax 注意力偏置，将关注重定向至安全关键交通参与者。
findings.evidence: 论文研究 Alpamayo-R1 基于 Qwen3-VL 主干的 VLA 驾驶模型，采用基于检测器定位的交通参与者视觉 token 注意力偏置，实现推理时的安全关注重定向。

findings.point: [27] 提出组合上下文微调 (CCFT) 方法，将装配动作分解为语义元素（动词、物体、工具）并微调 VLM，用于复杂装配动作理解。
findings.evidence: 方法将装配动作分解为 Verb/Object/Tool 语义元素，通过组合上下文微调适配 VLM，针对细粒度手-物交互与微小动作挑战。

findings.recommendation: ★★★☆☆ 与 VLA 微调范式相关，但任务限定在装配动作理解，非端到端动作生成

findings.evidence: 获胜方案使用 PPT + PTv3，通过平台特定条件化与跨数据集类别对齐策略，在无额外外部数据情况下显著提升 mIoU。

# 具身智能与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）前沿：2024-2026 七维增量快照

**日期**：2026-11-10（UTC） | **领域**：Embodied AI / VLA / Robotics | **检索源数量**：31 条（编号 [1]-[31]）  
**方法论**：依据 `deep-research`、`frontier-tracking`、`paper-survey`、`evidence-grading`、`frontier-watch` 五大 Skill 执行；所有论断强制引用 `[n]`，无来源处标注 `> 待核实`。

---

## 1. 进展与热点（Progress & Hotspots）

### 1.1 核心增量判断

## 3. 蓝海与缺口（Blue Ocean & Gaps）

### 3.1 核心增量判断
**蓝海集中在：① 统一的长时程真机评测协议 [22]；② 跨本体/跨任务的个性化/少样本适配 [31]；③ 推理时的轻量化安全对齐与可解释监控 [26][28][29]；④ 低成本、高质量的跨本体数据采集与标注范式（当前源无直接覆盖，需补齐）。**

### 3.2 结构化缺口清单

| 缺口维度 | 具体描述 | 支撑证据 | 优先级 | 备注 |
|----------|----------|----------|--------|------|
| **真机评测体系缺失** | 仿真基准显著推进，但通用策略的真机评测滞后，缺乏标准化 Sim-to-Real 评测协议 | [22] | ★★★★★ | 核心拦截器，阻碍产业化信心 |

| **个性化/少样本跨本体适配** | 缺乏面向用户偏好与新本体的少样本适配基准与方法 | [31] | ★★★★☆ | LIBERO-PeRM 刚建立基准，方法空白大 |

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点（Bottleneck & Inflection）

### 4.1 核心增量判断
**核心瓶颈为：长时程推理架构不成熟 [2]、Sim-to-Real 评测断层 [22]、基础模型透明度下降导致的可复现性危机 [4]、推理算力与延迟 [29]、安全关键场景下的分布外泛化 [26]。拐点信号：推理时干预 [26][28]、显式推理 [8]、低资源加速 [29] 正从“事后优化”转为“架构内生设计”。**

### 4.2 瓶颈与拐点对照表

| 瓶颈 | 当前状态 | 拐点信号 | 证据 | 判断置信度 |
|------|----------|----------|------|------------|
| **长时程推理/技能链式** | 仅有 Long-VLA [2]、LongNav-R1 [5] 两篇 2025-2026 预印本尝试，无统一真机基准 | 相位感知掩码、Horizon-Adaptive RL 成为架构标配；LIBERO-PeRM [31] 引入长时程个性化任务 | [2][5][31] | 较大概率 |
| **Sim-to-Real 评测断层** | 仿真 SOTA 频刷新，真机评测协议缺位 [22] | 学术界开始系统讨论评测设计挑战 [22]；BEHAVIOR [30] 等大规模仿真基准向真机迁移 | [22][30] | 确定（痛点共识） |
| **透明度/可复现性下降** | FMTI 2025 显示训练数据/算力/部署影响透明度大幅下降 [4] | 社区呼吁开放数据/权重/训练细节；OpenVLA/Octo 等开源基座缓解但头部模型闭源 | [4] | 确定（趋势明确） |
| **推理算力/延迟** | VLA 典型 7B-50B 参数，真机控制频率难达标 | BLURR [29] 等推理加速专项出现；蒸馏/量化/稀疏注意力成标配研究方向 | [29] | 较大概率 |
| **安全关键分布外泛化** | 训练时对齐覆盖有限；驾驶场景出现推理时注意力引导 [26] | “零重训练干预”范式从驾驶向通用操作迁移；注意力头监控 [28] 提供零样本异常检测 | [26][28] | 推测（跨域迁移不确定） |

### 7.3 风险与不确定性提示
- **数据版权与隐私风险**：FMTI 透明度下降 [4] 预示数据源合规审查趋严，可能限制大规模真机数据集公开。
- **仿真-真机 Gap 夸大风险**：BEHAVIOR [30] 等仿真榜单 SOTA 可能掩盖真机泛化失效，导致资源错配。
- **地缘政治断供风险**：高端算力（H100/B200/GB200）、高精度传感器、精密本体关键零部件的出口管制可能非线性冲击中国本土 VLA 训练与部署 `> 待核实`。
- **安全对齐失效风险**：推理时干预 [26] 仅在分布内验证，分布外极端场景下的失效模式未知。
